$comment: Expected model set for the MODEL REGISTRY guards (#385). This is the 'Supported models' table of
Anthropic's Claude Code model configuration support article, copied verbatim (label, id) on fetchedAt.
resources/model-registry.json must cover every id here or a release is refused.
Read by BOTH guards, which is why it lives in resources/ (packaged) and not scripts/fixtures/:
- scripts/release-gate.mjs   refuses the cut when the registry disagrees
- src/main/sentinel/sentinel-models.ts   tells the user at runtime, offline, no claude binary needed
How to refresh: open `source` in a browser (or `curl -sL <source> | grep -o 'claude-[a-z0-9-]*' | sort -u`),
rewrite `models` from the Supported models table in the article's order, set fetchedAt to today,
then run `node scripts/release-gate.mjs` and add any new model to resources/model-registry.json `models`
until the check passes. The picker rows are DERIVED from `models` (alias rows first, then a pinned row
per version under its family), so a new version needs no `dropdown` edit — `dropdown` is alias rows only.
Sentinel reports a stale snapshot after 90 days; keep fetchedAt honest.
